semPainel: The ground tester becomes available at the “Measure by moving stake P” step.

laudo.metodo: Method: ABNT NBR 15749 · IEEE 81 (fall of potential)

parecer.medida: Ground resistance measured at {{r}} Ω at 62% of the E–C distance (fall-of-potential method, ABNT NBR 15749).
parecer.naZona: The reading lies within the plateau zone (stable), which makes the measured value reliable.
parecer.foraZona: The plateau was not well defined — take more points near 62% and/or increase distance D.
parecer.ok: The value MEETS the utility recommendation (≤ 10 Ω).
parecer.falha: The value is ABOVE the utility recommendation (≤ 10 Ω) — improving the grounding system is recommended.

comoConcluir: How to finish: on the ground tester panel (right), move stake P and click “+ Record” at least at 3 different positions to build the curve.

terrometro.avance: Advance to the “Measure by moving stake P” step and start the measurement.
terrometro.pronto: Ready to calculate — or record more points.
terrometro.escolha: Choose the position, record and repeat — min. 3 points ({{n}}/3).
terrometro.naZona: Within the plateau zone — stable plateau, reliable reading.
terrometro.foraZona: Outside the plateau — take more points in the middle or increase distance D.

curva.vazia: move stake P and record the points
